svg.text: Laying out the activities and their order is its own
process. A simple project has no plan to open.
The name and the parent are one request. The kind is
The parent may be an idea, a goal or a progress
measure, or there may be none. The kind holds for the
Nothing is deleted. The parent keeps its link.
The activities and their tasks go with it. Nothing below a
There is no in-app undo. Recovery is from version
A project with no parent is legitimate. The counts are of
activities; a simple project has none.
Every form on this surface drafts as it is filled in, so
leaving it half-finished, a crash and a restart all cost
nothing. The draft is one-way: nothing waits for it to be
kept. Whichever write commits the form discards it.
The parent is single-valued and the user is never asked
what kind of thing it is.
Archiving a project is the only way an activity is archived
at all, and it is approved whole or rejected whole.
Everything the project is goes with it. Keeping anything
below it is not offered, because nothing below a project
One request creates either kind. The new template starts
from the default columns, one Backlog and one Done
among them. The kind is declared once and never
migrates. A plan orders and tracks; it carries no duration,
no float and no critical path.
An archived project is frozen until it is brought back, and
it comes back as the whole bundle it went as.
The parent survives a project's deletion. A goal left with
no linked idea is flagged on its current state.
